atoms.a: This place is very big. There are many people and tall buildings. It’s busy and loud.
This place is smaller than a city. There are shops and places to go, but it’s not very crowded.
This place is smaller than a town. There are not many houses or shops. It’s not very busy.

instruction.text: Which place is being described? Listen and write.

atoms.a: This place is dark and it smells like popcorn. You can watch films here.
People go here to travel by train to other places. It is often crowded.
You can study here. It is quiet and you can read or borrow books.
You can eat lunch or dinner here. You order food and sit at a table.
People buy food here. You buy things like fruit, bread and milk.
Hello Neeve! Where are you going this early?
atoms.b: Hello Niamh, ((where)) are you going this early?

atoms.a: Hey Matt, I’m going to the library. I have to return a book. Where are you going?
atoms.b: Hey Matt, I’m going to the ((library)). I have to return a book. Where are you going?

atoms.a: I’m going to the supermarket to pick up lunch for a friend. He works at the hospital.
atoms.b: I’m going to the ((supermarket)) to pick up lunch for a friend. He works at the ((hospital)).

atoms.a: Oh, that’s nice of you! Do you have any plans for the weekend? I was thinking about going to that new restaurant. Would you like to join me?
atoms.b: Oh, that’s nice of you! Do you have any plans for the weekend? I was thinking about going to that new ((restaurant)). Would you like to join me?

atoms.a: I’d love to. Maybe we can go to the park after that if the weather is nice.
atoms.b: I’d love to. Maybe we can go to the ((park)) after that if the weather is nice.

atoms.a: Sounds good! How about Saturday? On Sunday, I have to take my son to school for a special event.
atoms.b: Sounds good! How about Saturday? On Sunday, I have to take my son to ((school)) for a special event.

atoms.a: Oh, right! My daughter has something at her school too. Maybe we can also meet at the cafe later that day. They have amazing cakes.
atoms.b: Oh, right! My daughter has something at her school too. Maybe we can also meet at the ((cafe)) later that day. They have amazing cakes.

atoms.a: Where is Niamh on her way to?
atoms.sound: Where is Neeve on her way to?
b: She is going to the supermarket.
She is going to the park.

atoms.a: Why is Matt going to the supermarket?
b: ++He is picking up lunch for a friend.
He is buying food for dinner.
He is visiting his friend who works there.

atoms.a: Where do Niamh and Matt want to go on Saturday?
atoms.sound: Where do Neeve and Matt want to go on Saturday?
b: ++They want to go to a new restaurant.
They want to go to their children’s school.
They want to go to the library.
